targets.reason: its bound tests exercise regex compilation, the structural scan and verdict decoding in the host process, and V8 and JavaScriptCore backtrack at different speeds (measured 475ms vs 66ms for ^(a+)+$). The two potentially blocking match cases run in bounded children, but the scan and decode controls do not, so only the production Node engine gives a faithful verdict.
